title: How to Write Iambic Pentameter — A 13 Minute Crash Course
skills: apply stressed and unstressed syllable patterns in original writing
revise poetic lines for consistent meter and natural rhythm
alignment_note: Provides practical instruction for writing in iambic pentameter, moving from recognition of iambic rhythm to construction and revision of metrical lines. Supports poetry composition, prosody, scansion, rhythmic control, and understanding of formal verse across high school English courses.
